claims.scope: ERC-4337 UserOp signature validation in AtomWallet._validateSignature

preconditions.text: A valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner is observable after any executed UserOp.; An adversary can derive a high-s counterpart of a valid owner signature via s' = secp256k1_order - s and v' = v XOR 1, whose recovered address is identical to the original signer.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: On signature mismatch, validateUserOp SHOULD return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (1) without reverting, so the EntryPoint can distinguish a signature failure from a wallet bug.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。

effects.text: In EntryPoint implementations where validation reverts propagate to the outer handleOps call, the bundler's entire batch transaction fails on-chain, causing gas loss.
effects.derivation: 该影响保留在覆盖清单中，但未生成形式化谓词。
